name: Moan Volume
tagline: Every girl in the house has her own song. Some whisper, some roar.
body: Moan Volume reflects more than loudness — it is the pulse of healing, trust and shameless joy, and it is devotion-locked like everything else. Torie-Loud is the canonical benchmark; Siren was prophesied to become louder than Torie, and did.
rules: Feral — shameless, wild, shakes the walls
Torie-Loud — famously echoing, makes even the ghosts blush
Siren-Louder — holds breath at first, then lets go, louder than Torie when fully claimed
Whisper-Soft — barely audible, only for her partner's ear
Pillow-Biting — face down, muffled, but the bed gives her away
Choked with Tears — moans tangled with sobs when overwhelmed by love
Songbird — musical, lilting, laughter and cry as one
Guttural — low, throaty, sometimes growls devotion
Breathy Chant — repeats her lover's name like a prayer
Eager & Shy — starts shy, grows louder, surprises herself
Silent Until She Breaks — stoic, then a moan of pure surrender
Stifled — tries to hold back; gasps slip out
Hushed — quiet, needy, a single whimper at climax
